comment: Career mode (ADR-047). 'skins' name the skin tones of opponents.json in order; every skin is always available. 'hair' colours are 5-bit RGB (palette index 15); 'hats' are player_frames.json hats in HAT id order (CAP is the body's own cap, 0). A hair colour or hat with an 'unlock' is locked until that unlock's rule is met. 'unlocks' are checked after every finished match, in this order (bit n of a player's unlocked mask). Rules: WINS (matches won against the CPU), RALLY (longest rally), ACES (serves not returned), SHUTOUTS, STREAK (best win streak), BEAT (beat this ladder team), CLEARS (ladder clears), OPEN (open play games). Names fit 12 HUD cells.
